## What's new in 1.3.1

**Configure dialogs take clicks again.** In The Far Side, Dilbert and Star Wars Screen Entertainment modules, clicking a check box, slider or field in a module's Configure... window did nothing, so the options couldn't be changed. These dialogs draw 3-D frames around their options, and the frames were catching the clicks. Every option now responds to the mouse and the keyboard, and OK saves what you chose. After Dark's own dialogs were not affected.

Labels in those dialogs are also drawn in their proper font now, instead of a larger one that cut them off.
